headline: Major advancements in AI agents, models, and applications mark a significant day in the AI landscape
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by breakthroughs in AI agents, new models, and significant updates to existing tools. Companies like MoEngage, Anthropic, and Fika Jobs are leveraging AI for marketing, hiring, and productivity. Meanwhile, researchers are making strides in areas like ultrasound imaging for robots and multi-agent systems. OpenAI is contributing to shared standards for advanced AI, and NVIDIA is collaborating with AWS to bring AI to production at scale.

new_models.title: Sakana Fugu: Multi-Agent System as a Model
new_models.summary: Sakana AI’s Fugu behaves like one model from the outside while coordinating multiple expert agents internally.
new_models.why_it_matters: This approach could revolutionize how AI models are designed and interact with each other.

new_models.title: GPT-5 helped immunologist Derya Unutmaz solve a 3-year-old mystery
new_models.summary: GPT-5 Pro helped solve a 3-year-old immunology mystery, offering insights into T cell behavior.
new_models.why_it_matters: This demonstrates the potential of advanced AI models in scientific research and discovery.

research.title: Ultrasound imaging turns a robot hand into a skillful mimic
research.summary: Researchers have used ultrasound imaging to enable a robot hand to mimic human-like movements.
research.why_it_matters: This breakthrough could lead to significant advancements in robotics and human-robot interaction.

research.title: Build real agentic apps using CUGA: two dozen working examples on a lightweight harness
research.summary: CUGA provides a framework for building agentic apps with numerous examples and a lightweight harness.
research.why_it_matters: This could simplify the development of AI-powered applications and encourage more innovation in the field.

features_updates.title: Anthropic’s Claude Tag is learning your company, one Slack message at a time
features_updates.summary: Anthropic’s Claude Tag brings an always-on AI teammate to Slack, capturing organizational context and workflows.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This feature could significantly enhance productivity and collaboration within companies.

features_updates.title: How to Create Powerful Loops in Claude Code
features_updates.summary: This article provides guidance on creating powerful loops in Claude Code for more efficient coding.
features_updates.why_it_matters: Mastering loops in Claude Code can improve the effectiveness of AI coding agents.

industry_business.title: India’s MoEngage bets that the future of marketing is millions of AI agents
industry_business.summary: MoEngage has acquired technology to assign AI agents to individual customers, revolutionizing marketing.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This move indicates a significant shift towards AI-driven marketing strategies.

industry_business.summary: Fika Jobs is developing a hiring platform that combines AI interview agents with video profiles.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This platform could transform the hiring process, making it more efficient and personalized.

industry_business.title: NVIDIA and AWS Collaborate to Bring AI to Production at Scale
industry_business.summary: NVIDIA and AWS are collaborating to enable the production of AI systems at scale, addressing key constraints.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This partnership could accelerate the adoption of AI in various industries by making it more accessible and scalable.

policy_society.why_it_matters: Establishing shared standards is crucial for ensuring the safe and beneficial development of AI.
